niveles.descripcion: The page correctly determines the parity of the entered integer, including zero and negative values. It handles interaction through events, prevents form submission and page reload when needed, and displays the result on the page. It contains no console or debugging instructions. It uses strict mode, camelCase names, constants where no reassignment is needed, arrow functions as callbacks, consistent indentation and useful comments. Input validation is scored separately; the two criteria in section A total no more than 3 points. Justified intermediate scores are allowed according to demonstrated achievements and omissions.
The solution works in all cases, uses events and displays the result on the page. Some good practices are missing, without preventing the problem from being solved.
The solution works and uses events, but has widespread style problems, debugging instructions or incomplete interaction.
The runnable solution determines parity in some or all cases, but has significant errors in its logic or handling of interaction. Credit is proportional to the correct parts.

The program does not run because of syntax errors, but its code shows reasonably correct programming logic and a coherent approach to the problem. This level also covers a very incomplete solution with valid overall logic; successful execution is not required to recognise that approach.
Some relevant fragments are correctly planned, but they do not yet form a solution with sufficiently complete overall logic.
No answer, unrelated code or no relevant logic for solving the problem. Syntax errors alone do not justify zero when the approach deserves partial credit.

It is correctly integrated into the interaction. This score is added to the program score, with a combined maximum of 3 points.
